svg.title: 23. Palm up forearm turn — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Bend one elbow to a right angle and keep it next to your ribs. Turn that palm upwards. Support the wrist with the other hand and add a very small turn.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.cuh.nhs.uk/patient-information/hand-therapy-passive-wrist-exercises/
